headline: Vipul Limited holds annual general meeting for shareholders
hook: Routine business cleared by VIPUL shareholders
summary: Vipul Limited has formally concluded its annual general meeting for shareholders on November 12, 2026. During the meeting, standard corporate proceedings and resolutions were taken up as per statutory requirements. Such procedural filings are routine administrative updates for listed entities and do not alter the company's immediate financial standing. Retail investors holding shares in the company should note the completion of statutory compliance without any operational surprises.
why_it_matters: Purely procedural compliance with no direct financial impact for investors.

headline: Vipul Limited appoints Vikas Sharma as Company Secretary
hook: Leadership change in Vipul Limited secretarial office
summary: Vipul Limited has officially informed the NSE of the appointment of Mr. Vikas Sharma as the new Company Secretary. The appointment is effective from November 5, 2026. This is a routine corporate governance update for the company.
why_it_matters: Routine administrative change with no direct impact on stock price.

headline: Vipul Limited fixes November 5, 2026, as the record date for a meeting.
hook: November record date set by Vipul
summary: Vipul Limited has officially notified the exchange that November 5, 2026, will serve as the record date for an upcoming corporate meeting. This is a routine administrative filing for the listed company. Shareholders on record by this date will be eligible for participation or corporate actions tied to the meeting. Retail investors holding the stock need to note the date if they wish to participate in the scheduled proceedings.
why_it_matters: Routine meeting record date for Vipul shareholders.

headline: Vipul Limited informs stock exchanges about scheduled shareholders meeting
hook: Routine corporate governance filing from Vipul
summary: Vipul Limited has formally notified the stock exchanges regarding an upcoming shareholders meeting. Such meetings are standard corporate procedures required for approving resolutions or statutory matters. The company is listed on the National Stock Exchange under the symbol VIPULLTD. Indian retail investors holding shares in the company should check the meeting agenda for any critical business updates.
whats_next: Shareholders meeting date and agenda announcements
why_it_matters: Routine meeting details may affect voting rights for shareholders.

headline: Vipul Limited files financial results for June 2026
summary: Vipul Limited submitted its financial results for the period ended 30 June 2026 to the NSE. The filing provides the company's performance data for the quarter. Investors can review the results to assess the company's profitability and financial health. This filing may affect the stock price.
